_about: The oil & gas module's input catalog (#46): every input a person can change, with its label, kind and help. The dashboard's edit panel, 'Find an input', Ask's list_inputs / run_what_if / sweep / solve_for and saved scenarios all read this list, so the page needs no field code per input. scope 'case' paths are relative to a case (cases.<key>.<path>); a derived case shows its inherited value and stores only what you change. tests/test_oil_gas.py checks every path resolves and every deal-file input is here or in not_editable with a reason.
